loadedArtifacts.confidenceNotes: Official county detailxml.zip reports from the Iowa Secretary of State Clarity results app. The parser loads county certified presidential totals, precinct President-versus-U.S. House review rows, and VoterTurnout precinct ballotsCast/totalVoters rows. U.S. House remains district-based advisory comparison context.

loadedArtifacts.reportingGrain: statewide source review of county detail XML precinct turnout and President VoteType rows
loadedArtifacts.confidenceNotes: Documented exclusion only. The official SOS index was reviewed, and the county-selected Clarity detail XML reports were inspected. VoterTurnout precinct rows remain the active turnout source; President VoteType rows are candidate contest-vote method splits and are not loaded into the current public EAC participation-method CSV/API contract.

sourceFindings.parserOrNormalizationPath: scripts/report-ia-turnout-vote-method-source-review.mjs documents the source review; not normalized into the public vote-method CSV/API contract
sourceFindings.evidence: The retained review artifact confirms the official Iowa SOS results/statistics page is the submitted source index, county detail XML reports are county-selected ENR/Clarity report ZIPs, active VoterTurnout precinct rows sum to 1,651 rows, 1,672,068 ballots cast, and 1,893,715 registered voters, and President VoteType rows sum to 1,663,506 candidate votes split into Election Day and Absentee. President VoteType candidate votes are 8,562 below VoterTurnout ballotsCast.
sourceFindings.caveats: VoteType rows are candidate/contest votes by method, not all-ballot turnout by method. Do not expose them through the current public EAC participation-method API/UI contract unless a separate candidate-by-method contract, reconciliation checks, and UI caveat exist.
sourceFindings.feasibility: Feasible as a future candidate-by-method normalizer only if it clearly labels rows as contest-vote method splits, reconciles candidate VoteType sums to contest candidate totals, handles precinct names with punctuation/slashes, and avoids presenting the rows as all-ballot turnout by method.

sourceFindings.evidence: The Iowa SOS redistricting/reprecincting pages publish precinct and district shapefile indexes, including county precinct shapefile ZIP links.

scriptedAccessNotes.result: Wave 2 verification confirmed the official SOS page lists 2024 General Official Canvass by County, Precinct Results by County - Excel Format, Turnout Report, Statistical Reports, Daily Absentee Statistics, and General Election County Precinct Audits. The active machine-readable result/review/turnout source remains the county-selected Clarity detail XML package documented in data/ia-2024-turnout-vote-method-source-review.json.

Browser/web discovery identified official 2024 precinct results Excel, voter-registration totals, statistical reports, county precinct-audit image, and historical result/statistical-report leads. Direct scripted file download from sos.iowa.gov can return Cloudflare challenges from this environment.
Official Iowa SOS county precinct shapefile index identified as a geometry lead. ZIP artifacts are not collected or normalized in this pass.
Official 2024 General Election County Precinct Audits source lead identified; Invoke-WebRequest returned a Cloudflare browser challenge, so no local audit image was committed.
